newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK interbank rates, government paper yields steady.
newsitem.headline: HK interbank rates, government paper yields steady.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank rates and Exchange Fund paper yields were steady to a touch firmer on Tuesday, dealers said.
Overnight cash traded at 4-5/8 percent both ways versus 4-1/2 3/8 at Monday's midsession. Three-month money stood at 5-7/16 3/8 percent versus 5-7/16 5/16.
One-month Exchange Fund bills yielded 4.37 percent versus 4.36, and three-year notes yielded 6.14 percent versus 6.13.
Yields of seven-year notes edged up to 7.16 percent from 7.15. The longest 10-year notes carried yields of 7.44 percent versus 7.42. -- Carrie Lee (852) 2843 6369
